Both peer responses correctly identify the chronological impossibility of the Tenth Amendment being written using Pitman shorthand. The historical timeline is clear: the Tenth Amendment was ratified in 1791, whereas Pitman shorthand was not invented and published until 1837 by Sir Isaac Pitman. Furthermore, the physical manuscripts preserved in the National Archives are written in standard 18th-century longhand. 

I maintain my original answer and agree entirely with the peer responses.

Final answer: No
